CLAREMONT CITY COUNCIL
  MEETING AGENDA
  “We are a vibrant, livable, and inclusive community dedicated to quality services,
  safety, financial strength, sustainability, preservation, and progress
  with equal representation for our community.”

City Council Chamber  Tuesday
225 Second Street  September 10, 2024
Claremont, CA 91711
  6:30 PM

  COUNCILMEMBERS

  SAL MEDINA
  MAYOR

  JED LEANO  ED REECE  COREY CALAYCAY  JENNIFER STARK

Meetings are open to the public for in-person attendance. The meeting will be live streamed via Zoom,
technology permitting. Members of the public will not be able to provide public comment via Zoom. To
watch the meeting via Zoom, use the following link: https://zoom.us/j/256208090. To listen via telephone
dial (213)338-8477, Webinar ID: 256 208 090. The recorded meeting will be uploaded to the City
website and archived.

  OPTIONS FOR PUBLIC COMMENT

Public comment may be provided by one of the following methods. Each speaker will be given up to
three (3) minutes to provide their comment.

  IN-PERSON LIVE COMMENTS

When the item you wish to speak to is announced, please proceed to the speaker’s podium one by one.

  E-MAIL/MAIL

Written comments sent to the City Clerk’s office will be distributed to the City Council and imaged into
the record of the meeting. Email: sdesautels@ci.claremont.ca.us, jcostanza@ci.claremont.ca.us. Mail:
PO Box 880, Claremont, CA 91711. Written comments submitted after publication of the agenda will be
made available in the document archive system on the City website as soon as possible -
www.ci.claremont.ca.us.

  For assistance, comments, or more information please contact the City Clerk’s Office:
  (909) 399-5461 or (909) 399-5463.

MAYOR AND COUNCIL

Council Item
1.  APPOINTMENT OF MEMBERS TO CITY COMMISSIONS
  Recommendation:  The City Council Ad Hoc Selection Committee recommends the City Council
  make the following appointments:

  Planning Commission
  Richard Rosenbluth for a term to expire August 31, 2026

  Traffic and Transportation Commission
  Paul Wheeler for a term to expire August 31, 2026

Council Assignment Reports
City Councilmembers may serve as representatives on regional organizations. This time is
allocated for reports about their activities. For information about the Council's local,
intergovernmental  and  regional  appointments  please  visit  the  City website :
www.ci.claremont.ca.us/government/city-council/city-council-assignments-and-appointments.

CITY MANAGER REPORT

PUBLIC COMMENT
The Council has set aside this time for persons who wish to comment on items that are not listed
on the agenda, but are within the jurisdiction of the City Council. Members of the public will have
the opportunity to address the City Council regarding all items on the agenda at the time the
Council considers those items.

General public comment will be taken for 30 minutes and will resume later in the meeting if there
are speakers who did not get an opportunity to speak because of the 30-minute time limit.

The Brown Act prohibits the City Council from taking action on oral requests relating to items that
are not on the agenda. The Council may engage in a brief discussion, refer the matter to staff,
and/or schedule requests for consideration at a subsequent meeting.

CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed on the Consent Calendar are considered routine. The City Council may act on
these items by one motion following public comment. Only Councilmembers may pull an item from
the Consent Calendar for discussion, reading of resolutions and ordinances will be waived.
 Page 4  City Council Agenda  September 10, 2024

2.  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTIONS APPROVING THE CITY WARRANT REGISTER
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council:
  A. Adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  CLAREMONT,  CALIFORNIA,  ALLOWING CERTAIN CLAIMS AND
  DEMANDS AND SPECIFYING THE FUNDS OUT OF WHICH THE SAME
  ARE TO BE PAID, dated August 1, 2024;
  B. Adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  CLAREMONT,  CALIFORNIA,  ALLOWING CERTAIN CLAIMS AND
  DEMANDS AND SPECIFYING THE FUNDS OUT OF WHICH THE SAME
  ARE TO BE PAID, dated August 15, 2024; and
  C. Adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  CLAREMONT,  CALIFORNIA,  ALLOWING CERTAIN CLAIMS AND
  DEMANDS AND SPECIFYING THE FUNDS OUT OF WHICH THE SAME
  ARE TO BE PAID, dated August 29, 2024.
  Attachment(s):  Resolution Approving City Warrant Register Dated August 1, 2024
  Resolution Approving City Warrant Register Dated August 15, 2024
  Resolution Approving City Warrant Register Dated August 29, 2024

3.  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES OF JULY 23, 2024 (SPECIAL AND REGULAR)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council approve the special and regular City
  Council meeting minutes of July 23, 2024.
  Attachment(s):  Draft Special Meeting Minutes of July 23, 2024
  Draft Regular Meeting Minutes of July 23, 2024

4.  RESOLUTION AMENDING CITY COUNCIL RESOLUTION NO. 2024-30 UPDATING THE
  SALARY SCHEDULE FOR THE CLAREMONT ADMINISTRATIVE AND TECHNICAL
  SUPPORT EMPLOYEES’ ASSOCIATION AND A RESOLUTION ADOPTING A SALARY
  SCHEDULE FOR THE POSITION OF CITY MANAGER
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council:
  A. Adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING RESOLUTION NO. 2024-30
  UPDATING  THE  SALARY  SCHEDULE FOR  THE  CLAREMONT
  ADMINISTRATIVE  AND  TECHNICAL  SUPPORT  EMPLOYEES'
  ASSOCIATION; and
  B. Adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING A SALARY SCHEDULE FOR THE
  POSITION OF CITY MANAGER.
  Attachment(s):  Resolution Revising Resolution No. 2024-30
  Resolution Adopting Salary Schedule for City Manager
 Page 5  City Council Agenda  September 10, 2024

5.  AWARD OF CONTRACT TO RDO EQUIPMENT, CO. FOR THE PURCHASE OF A MINI
  SKID STEER (FUNDING SOURCE: CEMETERY FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council award a contract to RDO Equipment, Co.
  in the amount of $60,694.77 for the purchase of a mini skid steer and
  authorize the City Manager to execute the contract.
6.  AWARD OF CONTRACT TO PRECISION CONCRETE CUTTING, INC. FOR A CITYWIDE
  SIDEWALK CONDITION ASSESSMENT (FUNDING SOURCE: MEASURE R FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council award a contract to Precision Concrete
  Cutting, Inc. for a citywide sidewalk condition assessment and authorize the
  City Manager to enter into an agreement in the amount of $104,650, plus a
  ten percent contingency of $10,465, for a total amount not to exceed
  $115,115.
7.  AWARD OF CONTRACT TO OTL BUILDERS, INC. FOR THE BLAISDELL COMMUNITY
  CENTER KITCHEN REMODEL PROJECT (FUNDING SOURCE: GENERAL CAPITAL
  PROJECTS FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council:
  A. Award a contract to OTL Builders, Inc. in the amount of $69,300 for the
  Blaisdell Community Center Kitchen Remodel Project and authorize a ten
  percent contingency in the amount of $6,930, for a total amount not to
  exceed $76,230; and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement;
  B. Authorize the City Manager to enter into an agreement with Lotus
  Construction Group in the amount of $7,000 for project management
  services;
  C. Appropriate $83,230 in General Capital Projects Funds for the Blaisdell
  Community Center Kitchen Remodel Project; and
  D. Authorize acceptance of $83,230 from the Claremont Senior Foundation,
  Inc. to fund the Blaisdell Community Center Kitchen Remodel Project.
8.  AWARD OF CONTRACT TO TRIO COMMUNITY MEALS, LLC. FOR PROFESSIONAL
  SENIOR NUTRITION PROGRAM CATERING SERVICES (FUNDING SOURCE: NUTRITION
  FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council authorize the City Manager to enter into a
  professional services agreement with Trio Community Meals, LLC, in an
  amount not to exceed $102,750 for a term of October 1, 2024, to June 30,
  2025, with an option to renew for three additional one-year extensions.
  Should the agreement be extended, compensation will be increased at an
  amount commensurate with the April-April Consumer Price Index (CPI) not to
  exceed three percent in each subsequent year, not to exceed a total of
  $141,100 in the second year, $145,250 in the third year, and $149,608 in
  the fourth year, for a total contract amount not to exceed $538,718.
  Attachment(s):  Approved Caterers, FY 2024-25
 Page 6  City Council Agenda  September 10, 2024

9.  ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION ESTABLISHING UNDERGROUND UTILITY DISTRICT 24
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council:
  A. Adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, ESTABLISHING UNDERGROUND UTILITY
  DISTRICT NO. 24; and
  B. Find this item is exempt from environmental review under the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA).
  Attachment(s):  Southern California Edison Rule 20 Guidelines
  Underground Utility District No. 24 Map
  Resolution

PUBLIC HEARING
Public Hearings will not begin before 7:00 p.m.
10. TAX EQUITY AND FISCAL RESPONSIBILITY ACT OF 1982 HEARING TO APPROVE THE
  ISSUANCE OF UP TO $36 MILLION IN TAX EXEMPT FINANCING BY THE CALIFORNIA
  MUNICIPAL FINANCE AUTHORITY FOR THE BENEFIT OF SCRIPPS COLLEGE
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council adopt a RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING THE
  ISSUANCE OF THE CALIFORNIA MUNICIPAL FINANCE AUTHORITY 2024
  TAX EXEMPT LOAN (SCRIPPS COLLEGE) IN AN AGGREGATE
  PRINCIPAL AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED OF $36,000,000 FOR THE
  FINANCING AND REFINANCING ALL OR A PORTION OF THE COSTS OF
  THE ACQUISITION, CONSTRUCTION, RENOVATION, RETROFITTING,
  EQUIPPING  AND  IMPROVEMENT  OF  CERTAIN  EDUCATIONAL
  FACILITIES, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO: ADMINISTRATIVE
  FACILITIES, SITE IMPROVEMENTS, STUDENT HOUSING FACILITIES,
  FACULTY  HOUSING  FACILITIES,  AND  PARKING,  OWNED  AND
  OPERATED BY SCRIPPS COLLEGE, LOCATED WITHIN THE CITY, AND
  CERTAIN OTHER MATTERS RELATING THERETO.
  Attachment(s):  Scripps College TEFRA Resolution

ORDINANCE
11. AMENDMENT TO CLAREMONT MUNICIPAL CODE TITLE 18 TO AMEND SUBSECTION (C)
  OF SECTION 18.015.030 PERTAINING TO REAL ESTATE “OPEN HOUSE” SIGNAGE
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council introduce for first reading, and that
  reading be by title only AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING AN AMENDMENT TO
  CLAREMONT  MUNICIPAL  CODE  TITLE  18 THAT  WILL  AMEND
  SUBSECTION (C) OF CHAPTER SECTION 18.015.030 OF TITLE 18
  (SIGNS) PERTAINING TO REAL ESTATE "OPEN HOUSE" SIGNAGE.
  Attachment(s):  Proposed Ordinance
 Page 7  City Council Agenda  September 10, 2024

ADMINISTRATIVE ITEMS - None

CONTINUED PUBLIC COMMENT
This time is reserved for those persons who were unable to speak earlier in the agenda because
of the 30-minute time restriction.

COMMISSIONS - no vacancies

ADJOURNMENT
